name: Mountaineer Kadrell
summary: Across from the Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar, Mountaineer Kadrell keeps watch over Loch Modan.

sections.title: The Sentry of Thelsamar
sections.body: Mountaineer Kadrell keeps watch in Thelsamar and organizes the dwarven defenses of Loch Modan. Outposts along the valley’s fringes face pressure from troggs, gnolls, and native beasts. From the center of town, Kadrell organizes reinforcements, relays orders, and weighs reports from scouts in the field.

sections.title: Keeping the Lines Open
sections.body: Mountaineer Kadrell keeps in touch with Thelsamar’s remote forward posts. He coordinates with Mountaineer Stormpike and sends adventurers to report to sentries such as Mountaineer Rockgar. The outposts guard the mountain passes, and Kadrell helps get them supplies, reinforcements, and word of threats.

faq.q: Where can Mountaineer Kadrell be found?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Kadrell stands across the road from the Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar, among the rolling hills of Loch Modan.

faq.q: What is Kadrell's role in Loch Modan?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Kadrell serves with the dwarven Mountaineers, carrying messages between Thelsamar’s local leaders and remote guard posts. He coordinates patrols, supplies, and border reports.

faq.q: Why do other mountaineers send runners to Kadrell?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Kadrell is stationed by Thelsamar’s inn and main thoroughfare, making him a natural point for field dispatches. Urgent reports from distant scouts reach the settlement’s defenses through him.
Mountaineer Kadrell works with other mountaineers in the field, including Mountaineer Stormpike and Mountaineer Rockgar. They share scouting reports and arrange defenses against local threats.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler passing through Thelsamar, you can carry messages and aid distant mountaineer outposts facing regional threats.
As a dwarf, you know Kadrell belongs to the Mountaineer corps, whose watch protects Ironforge’s eastern territories from dangers in the wilderness.
